ezinsar.cli

package documentation
(source)

Wrapper of EZ-InSAR

The module contains a set of Python applications to execute EZ-InSAR by command-line interface.

Example

EZ-InSAR can be launched using the following command:

$ ezinsar <command> [<args>...]

Please use the help argument to display the help:

$ ezinsar --help
